thread:
Sofia: quick design question from today's kickoff: when A/B fallback fires, should we pin a tenant to a stable "anchor" or use a single global anchor? noticed traffic thrash across tenants.
Ravi: pinning per-tenant reduces noisy interference. downside is more state and route lookups. could we prefer tenant anchors but have a fallback global anchor for sparse tenants?
Dana: agree. implement a "preference order": tenant_pinned -> tenant_previous -> global_previous -> safe_stub. prefer tenant if confidence metric > threshold.
Oliver: what is confidence? samples + stability. proposal: require samples >= 200 and variance_ratio < 1.4. add decay so anchor confidence halves every 48h.
Sofia: circuit conditions: require both a probabilistic signal (posterior that canary worse by delta >= 0.97) AND a hard threshold (error-rate > 1.5% OR p95 > 400ms) to auto-fallback. short-circuits for severe spikes.
observability-bot: ALERT: canary/model-4 p95 +30% in ap-south with samples=95. link: https://obs.local/d/zzzz
Ravi: samples < min: do NOT auto-fallback. create Ops ticket and increase probe rate for that variant.
Dana: scoring sketch:
score = 0.6 * latency_delta_norm + 0.3 * error_norm + 0.1 * quality_regression_norm
adjusted = score * (1 - exp(-samples/350))
trigger if samples>=200 and posterior>0.97 and adjusted>0.7
Sofia: fallback choreography: graceful rampdown by default: reduce canary by 25% every 45s. immediate kill only if both error-rate>3% AND p95>700ms. always emit structured fallback_event with reason_code, posterior, adjusted_score, sample_count, anchor_used.
Oliver: implementation notes: store anchors in small KV: key=(tenant,model_family)->anchor,confidence,last_seen,sample_count; TTL=14d; shard by tenant_id%64. cache in proxy with 20s TTL and background warmer for rising traffic.
Ravi: tests: add a small canary-sim to CI: jitter, correlated outages, semantic regressions. run sims to pick priors and thresholds.
Sofia: action items: @Dana draft RFC with: anchor lifecycle, confidence math, fallback state machine, observability hooks, ops runbook. @Oliver prototype proxy cache. @Ravi own sims and priors. Ops: disable auto-fallback until min-sample rule enforced.
Dana: will do, ETA EOW for an RFC sketch.
Sofia: thanks — keeping auto-fallback conservative for now.
